ऊ: ऊ (encl.) and, also, yet, now, soon, again;  lays stress on a prec. pron., particle or infin. in तवै (तवा उ);  उ षु ( = सु) right soon, मो ( = माउ) षु never. उ-उ (or उत) on the one hand-on the other hand, as well-as.
ऊढ: ऊढ॑ a. carried, borne;  n. load, prey;  f. आ bride, wife.
ऊति: 1 ऊति॑ f. (m.) furtherance, help, aid, refreshment;  helper, furtherer, protector.
ऊधन्: ऊ॑धन् n. udder, bosom, lap, the cloudy sky.
ऊधर्: ऊ॑धर् n. udder, bosom, lap, the cloudy sky.
ऊधस्: ऊ॑धस् n. udder, bosom, lap, the cloudy sky.
ऊन: ऊन॑ a. wanting, incomplete;  inferior to, less than (abl. or —°);  less by (instr. or —°);  °— in numerals = एकोन, i.e. minus one.
ऊनद्विवार्षिक: ऊनद्विवार्षिक a. less than two years old.
ऊनय्: ऊनय् ऊन॑यति leave unfulfilled (a wish);  pp. ऊनित lessened by (instr.).
ऊरु: ऊरु॑ m. thigh (adj. —° f. ऊरु or ऊरू);  N. of an old sage.
ऊरुसंभव: ऊरुसंभव a. born from the thigh.
ऊरुस्कम्भ: ऊरुस्कम्भ॑ m. paralysis of the thigh.
ऊर्ज्: ऊ॑र्ज् f. sap, food;  vigour, strength.
ऊर्ज: ऊर्ज॑ a. strong;  m. & f. आ॑ = prec.
ऊर्जय्: ऊर्जय् ऊर्ज॑यति pp. ऊर्जित (q.v.) feed, strengthen;  M. be strong or exuberant;  ऊर्ज॑यन्त् tr. or intr.
ऊर्जावत्: ऊ॑र्जावन्त् a. giving strength;  also = seq.
ऊर्जावन्त्: ऊ॑र्जावन्त् a. giving strength;  also = seq.
ऊर्जित: ऊर्जित a. strong, powerful, n. adv.
ऊर्ण: ऊर्ण m. N. of a Yakṣa;  n. & f. ऊ॑र्णा wool, a spider's thread.

ऊर्ध्व: ऊर्ध्व॑ a. going upwards, raised, elevated, upright, erect, high (mostly °—). — n. eminence, height;  as adv. & prep. upwards, aloft, in(to) heaven (w. गम् die), above (abl.);  in the sequel, afterwards, later;  beyond, from, since, after (abl.);  later than i.e. after the death of (gen.);  in a high tone, aloud. — Cf. अ॑तस् & इत॑स्.
ऊर्ध्वक: ऊर्ध्वक a. raised;  n. adv. loud.*
ऊर्ध्वकर: ऊर्ध्वकर a. with lifted hands or rising rays.
ऊर्ध्वकर्ण: ऊर्ध्वकर्ण a. having the ears pricked up.
ऊर्ध्वगति: ऊर्ध्वगति a. the same;  f. subst.
ऊर्ध्वगमन: ऊर्ध्वगमन n. rising (of stars), also = prec. f.
ऊर्ध्वचूड: ऊर्ध्वचूड a. tied up in a tuft (hair).*
ऊर्ध्वदेह: ऊर्ध्वदेह n. funeral ceremony (lit. the body above).
ऊर्ध्वनभस्: ऊर्ध्व॑नभस् a. being above the clouds.
ऊर्ध्वपथ: ऊर्ध्वपथ n. the sky (lit. upper path).
ऊर्ध्वपाद: ऊर्ध्वपाद a. having the heels upwards;  m. the point of the foot.
ऊर्ध्वपुण्ड्र: ऊर्ध्वपुण्ड्र m. the perpendicular line on the forehead of a Brahman.

ऊर्ध्वबृहती: ऊर्ध्वबृहती f. N. of a metre.

ऊर्ध्वराजि: ऊर्ध्वराजि f. a line running upwards.
ऊर्ध्वरेत: ऊर्ध्व॑रेत a. chaste (lit. having the semen above).
ऊर्ध्वरेतस्: ऊर्ध्व°रेतस् a. chaste (lit. having the semen above).
ऊर्ध्वलोक: ऊर्ध्वलोक m. the upper world, heaven.
ऊर्ध्ववृत: ऊर्ध्ववृत a. put on or worn above (i.e. on the shoulder).
ऊर्ध्वसानु: ऊर्ध्व॑सानु a. having the neck raised.
ऊर्ध्वाङ्गुलि: ऊर्ध्वाङ्गुलि a. having the fingers raised.
ऊर्मि: ऊर्मि॑ m. f. wave, current, flood;  metaph. of the (six) human infirmities.
ऊर्मिमाला: ऊर्मिमाला f. a wreath or row of waves.
ऊर्म्य: ऊ॑म्र्य a. undulating, agitated;  f. ऊ॑म्र्या night.
ऊर्व: ऊर्व॑ m. receptacle, esp. of water, i.e. cloud;  fence, fold, stable, prison;  N. of an ancient sage.
ऊष: ऊ॑ष m. ऊषा & ई f. alkaline earth.
ऊषर: ऊषर॑ a. impregnated with salt;  s. = seq.
ऊषरक्षेत्र: ऊषरक्षेत्र n. saline or barren soil.*
ऊष्मन्: ऊष्म॑न् m. heat, steam, ardour, passion.
ऊष्मप: ऊष्मप a. drinking (only) the steam of food;  m. pl. a class of Manes.
ऊह्: 1 ऊह् (उह्) ऊ॑हति ऊहते pp. ऊढ & ऊहित shift, change. — अधि put on;  raise above (loc.). अप push off, remove, destroy;  avoid, shun, give up. व्यप dispel, remove, destroy. अभि overlay, cover. अव push down. उद् push upwards, bring forth. अभ्युद् push on, push further. व्युद् push asunder, move away, sweep out. उप push near, insert, produce. समुप bring near, offer. निस् push out, pull out, remove. परि heap or pile round, surround, fortify. प्रति push back, strip off, doff, remove;  keep off, detain; reject, refuse;  outstrip, surpass, excel;  disturb, interrupt. वि push asunder, separate;  divide, arrange (esp. in battle-array). प्रतिवि arrange in return. सम् bring together, gather, collect. परिसम् sweep together. — Cf. उद्व्यूढ, उपोढ, निव्र्यूढ, व्यूढ.

2 ऊह् ओहते ऊहति ओहते ऊह°ते mind, mark, watch, wait or lurk for (acc. or loc.);  conceive, understand;  be regarded as, pass for (nom.). — अपि conceive, comprehend, guess. अभि wait or lurk for (acc.), also = prec. नि mind, notice.
ऊहनीय: ऊहनीय a. to be changed or modified.
ऊहनीय a. to be examined or found out.
ऊह्य: 1 ऊह्य a. to be changed or modified.
2 ऊह्य a. to be examined or found out.
